properties.SQL:
SELECT original.nome,
       original.prezzo,
       COALESCE(CAST(enrichment.quantita AS VARCHAR), 'null') AS quantita
FROM original
LEFT OUTER JOIN enrichment ON original.nome = enrichment.nome

properties.solo_frutta:
SELECT nome, prezzo
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE source = 'frutta'

properties.SQL:
SELECT original.nome, original.prezzo, enrichment.quantita 
FROM original 
INNER JOIN enrichment ON original.nome = enrichment.nome

SELECT enrichment.nome,
       COALESCE(CAST(original.prezzo AS VARCHAR), 'null') AS prezzo,
       enrichment.quantita
FROM original
RIGHT OUTER JOIN enrichment ON original.nome = enrichment.nome

properties.report_solo_magazzino:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.nome) AS solo_magazzino
FROM FLOWFILE f
RIGHT JOIN FLOWFILE m ON f.nome = m.nome AND f.source = 'frutta' 
WHERE m.source = 'magazzino' AND f.nome IS NULL
properties.report_solo_frutta:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.nome) AS solo_frutta
FROM FLOWFILE f 
LEFT JOIN FLOWFILE m ON f.nome = m.nome 
AND m.source = 'magazzino' 
WHERE f.source = 'frutta' AND m.nome IS NULL
properties.report_in_comune:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.nome) AS in_comune
FROM FLOWFILE f 
JOIN FLOWFILE m ON f.nome = m.nome 
WHERE f.source = 'frutta' AND m.source = 'magazzino'

properties.solo_magazzino:
SELECT nome, quantita
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE source = 'magazzino'
